description: Pinned public Sentinel-2 L2A sample for STAC radiometric conversion validation; imagery is fetched only by the opt-in network test.

provenance.pixel_verification: Independent GDAL gdallocationinfo range read at longitude -1.29, latitude 52.51 returned column 1604, row 8090, blue DN 4636.
provenance.formula: reflectance = stored_value * scale + offset; Clay DN convention = reflectance / 0.0001.
provenance.note: Per-asset raster:bands metadata is authoritative for this test; no offset is inferred from the item processing baseline or earthsearch:boa_offset_applied flag. Cloudy imagery is intentional: this verifies numerical input handling, not prediction quality.
